name: jit_inline_above_cost
description: Sets the minimum estimated query execution cost threshold above which JIT compilation attempts to inline functions and operators.
symptoms: No performance improvement for simple queries
tuning_tips: Increase this value to reduce JIT inlining overhead on simpler queries; decrease it (but not below jit_above_cost) to enable inlining earlier for complex queries. Set to -1 to disable inlining entirely.
